title: Determining Whether Conviction Records under Repealed Section 377a of Penal Code Should be Rendered Spent
what_it_is: Determining Whether Conviction Records under Repealed Section 377a of Penal Code Should be Rendered Spent

sections.label: Section 377A records spent
sections.summary: Factors for rendering section 377A records spent, 302 convictions, 17 persons convicted 1988-2007, and MHA considering proactive spending.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Apart from whether the case was a private activity and whether it was between consenting adults, the other factors that the Commissioner of Police will consider will not be different from how he would have to assess other applications to render criminal records spent.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: These factors include the severity of the offence and the applicant's conduct subsequent to the conviction.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In total, there have been 302 individuals convicted under section 377A.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: It is important to note that the large majority of these cases involved acts committed in public, committed against non-consenting victims or committed against a minor.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Such conduct remains criminalised today through other offences.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We have not prosecuted anyone for private, consensual homosexual conduct between adults since 2007.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We have also previously stated in response to media queries that based on our records, there are 17 persons who were convicted between 1988 and 2007 for consensual, private homosexual acts between adults who are still alive today, and five of these 17 individuals have already had their conviction records automatically spent after the five-year crime-free period.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The Police have not received any application from the public to have their section 377A record rendered spent, but the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) will consider how the records of these persons can be rendered spent proactively.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I would have to check on the specificity of this.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But based on my recollection, MHA does not provide the reasons.
